requirements.description: Sic Bo publishes private dice preparation, wager and payout recovery markers, settlement state, bounded history, and action-owned cleanup through provider-current callbacks that replace only game-owned fields. Competing processes serialize distinct preparations, preserve unrelated player-state siblings and terminal history, and prevent stale cleanup from erasing an advanced winner, while the frozen v1 envelope, fifty-position rules, server entropy, and exactly-once ledger movements remain unchanged.
requirements.notes: The SimpleWagerGame lifecycle adapter now owns each provider-current transition without a detached whole-document saver. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because wallet and game-state publication remain separate durable boundaries.

requirements.description: Sic Bo delegates its prepared wager, committed-dice recovery, optional payout credit, replay lookup, lifecycle finalization, and provider-current history publication to one SimpleWagerGame coordinator while preserving the frozen v1 action_id, sb_ round identity, direct oldest-to-newest fifty-round history, public round, active-state privacy, and historical ledger evidence semantics.
requirements.notes: The game service contains exactly one SimpleWagerGame construction and no direct GameSettlementGateway, CoreLedgerGateway, or apply_once call. Canonical proof fields remain beside the legacy sic_bo_action_id compatibility field without changing the frozen v1 contract.
